description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it. (Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.)
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors. (Password must be at least 8 characters.)
A customer under 18 years old cannot register. (Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old.")

cases.title: Register successfully with all required fields valid and sign in with the new account
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used (e.g. new.user@example.com) is not registered in the system.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the user clearly over 18 (e.g. 1990-05-10).
Open the sign-in page and sign in with new.user@example.com / Passw0rd123.
cases.expected: The account is created and the user can sign in with the registered email and password. (Exact confirmation wording and post-registration redirect are not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration is rejected when a required field is left empty
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered.
steps: Enter last name: Novak, date of birth: 1990-05-10, email: empty.field@example.com, password: Passw0rd123.
Leave the first name field empty.
Attempt to sign in with empty.field@example.com / Passw0rd123.
cases.expected: The account is not created (first name is a required field) and sign-in with those credentials does not succeed. The exact error message/handling for the empty required field is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email shows a clear error and creates no duplicate account
cases.preconditions: An account already exists with email existing.user@example.com.
steps: Enter first name: Petr, last name: Dvorak, date of birth: 1985-03-20.
Check the account list / data store for accounts using existing.user@example.com.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown stating the email is already registered (exact wording not specified in the story) and no duplicate account is created — only the original account with that email exists.

cases.title: Invalid email format produces an inline validation error
steps: Enter first name: Anna, last name: Novak, date of birth: 1990-05-10.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field and the account is not created. (Exact error text not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Password shorter than 8 characters produces an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered.
steps: Enter first name: Anna, last name: Novak, date of birth: 1990-05-10.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field (minimum length 8 characters) and the account is not created. (Exact error text not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered.
steps: Enter first name: Anna, last name: Novak, date of birth: 1990-05-10.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown; the account is created and the user can sign in with it.

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register and sees the age message
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter first name: Tomas, last name: Maly.
Enter date of birth: a date that makes the user 17 years old today (today's date minus 17 years).
Attempt to sign in with minor.user@example.com / Passw0rd123.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown, the account is not created, and sign-in with those credentials does not succeed.

cases.title: Customer who turns 18 exactly today can register
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter first name: Eva, last name: Horak.
Enter date of birth: exactly today's date minus 18 years.
cases.expected: The age message "You must be at least 18 years old." is not shown (the customer is not under 18) and the account is created.

cases.title: Customer one day short of 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email used is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter first name: Jan, last name: Svoboda.
Enter date of birth: today's date minus 18 years, plus one day (18th birthday is tomorrow).
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and the account is not created.
